recipe: inkid-statuslist-v1: a bitstring of 131072 entries, one per record slot. Entry i is bit (7 - (i mod 8)) of byte floor(i / 8) — the most significant bit of each byte is the first, so entry 0 is the leftmost bit of byte 0. A 1 means the purpose named by statusPurpose applies to the record holding that slot; a 0 means it does not, and says nothing else about the record. The bitstring is GZIP-compressed (RFC 1952) with the header MTIME, XFL and OS bytes fixed to 0x00000000, 0x00 and 0xFF so one set of bits always produces one string; a decoder MUST accept any valid GZIP stream. The result is base64url-encoded without padding (RFC 4648 section 5) and prefixed with the multibase character 'u'. The document is signed with ES256 over the UTF-8 bytes of canonicalJson(document minus the signature field) — the same canonicalisation as inkid-orgsig-v3 — under the key named by signature.keyId and published at org_keys/{keyId}.
